modelIds.description: Models in priority order. Position 0 is tried first, then 1, etc. Each id must reference a VERIFIED or STALE row for the chosen provider.

AddProviderKeyResponse.description: Identity + assigned priority of the newly inserted credential row.

latencyMs.description: Probe wall-clock duration in milliseconds, when measured.

error.description: Provider-side error indicator on FAILED outcomes.

failedCountLast24h.description: FAILED rows in the last 24h (numerator of failureRateLast24h). Pair with sampleSizeLast24h to render an honest count when the sample is too small for a meaningful percentage.

sampleSizeLast24h.description: Rows created in the last 24h (denominator of failureRateLast24h). When small (e.g. < 10) the client should show counts, not a percentage — 1/1 = 100% alarms without informing.

AdminMeResponse.description: Authenticated admin's identity, returned by GET /api/admin/me.

role.description: Static role identifier; always ADMIN for authenticated admins.

ProviderKey.description: One platform credential row in a provider's failover chain

ProviderKeyList.description: Priority-ordered failover chain for one provider

modelIds.description: Models in priority order; position 1 is tried first.

ApiError.description: RFC 9457 ProblemDetail extended with code/params/fieldErrors. Wire shape produced by Spring 7 ProblemDetail.setProperty(...) flattened by Jackson 3 ProblemDetailJacksonMixin. Phase 1.1 introduces this contract; the FE switches on `code`.

type.description: RFC 9457 problem type URI; defaults to `about:blank`.

title.description: Generic English diagnostic. NOT the user-facing message — FE ignores it.

status.description: HTTP status code echoed in the body.

detail.description: Generic English diagnostic. NOT the user-facing message — FE ignores it.

instance.description: Optional URI identifying this specific occurrence.

code.description: Stable dotted hierarchical key (e.g. `error.auth.unauthorized`). Frontend localizes via the errors.* dictionary. ALWAYS PRESENT.

additionalProperties.description: Allow-listed scalar value: string, integer, number, or boolean. Filtered through AllowedParamScalars before serialization.

params.description: Allow-listed ICU placeholder scalars for the FE error message. Filtered through AllowedParamScalars; never carries raw user content, Gmail body fragments, SQL constraint names, or exception class names.

fieldErrors.description: Per-field validation errors. Present only on validation failures.

message.description: Transitional alias of `code`, kept for one phase per CONTEXT.md decision D-C1. Prefer `code`.

FieldErrorDto.description: Per-field validation error. CONTEXT.md decision D-C2: { field, code, params }. The JHipster `message` and `objectName` fields are deliberately rejected — the frontend localizes the dotted `code` via the errors.field.* dictionary.

field.description: Dotted path to the offending field, e.g. `email`, `templates[0].key`.

code.description: Dotted hierarchical key inside the errors.field.* namespace.

additionalProperties.description: Allow-listed scalar value: string, integer, number, or boolean. Filtered through AllowedParamScalars before serialization.

params.description: Allow-listed scalars (numbers, booleans, dotted keys, short resource identifiers). Never raw user content.
